**Senior AI Engineer**

Apptopia is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to join our dynamic, data-driven team at a high-growth startup backed by powerhouse investors like Mark Cuban and ABS Capital. We specialize in providing actionable competitive intelligence to investment firms and financial institutions by estimating worldwide downloads, revenues, and active users for every mobile app. We also provide a unique, highly valued product with app user behavior insights. Our actionable app-store data and intuitive business intelligence tool help companies like Google, Facebook, and top hedge funds make smarter decisions.

Apptopia is hiring a Senior AI Engineer to lead our push into LLMs, agentic systems, and AI-driven product innovation.

You'll design and build intelligent systems that combine LLM reasoning, structured data, and tool orchestration—shaping how we use AI across our product and company.

**Responsibilities**

* You will be a Senior AI Engineer on the Product team where you will work on incorporating LLM powered systems into new data products, advance our existing products and help shape Apptopia's long term AI strategy.
* You will spearhead efforts to incorporate LLM powered systems as we bring new finance focused products to market

* Design and implement agentic workflows that combine LLM reasoning, structured data, and external tools to accelerate new product delivery
* Experiment with multi-step reasoning systems, RAG, tool orchestration, and emerging paradigms to improve analyst workflows
* Design, develop, and implement machine learning algorithms to advance a broad set of use cases including app usage trend forecasting, consumer behavior prediction,, stock price movement estimation, user segmentation
* You will take part, and in many cases lead the thought process for improving core modeling efforts:

* Identify opportunities to extend existing modeling work into AI-native systems that integrate predictions, reasoning, and automation
* Identify opportunities to augment core datasets with LLM-derived features, classifications, and insights
* Research, identify, and test ensemble methodologies to continuously improve accuracy and coverage in our models used for core app usage estimates
* You will be a key thought leader in development of our AI platform and infrastructure: Contribute to the design of internal AI platforms that enable teams to leverage LLMs at scale

* Lead rapid experimentation cycles to evaluate new LLM capabilities, architectures, and vendors
* Define frameworks for evaluating LLM quality, reliability, and cost-performance tradeoffs
Partner with product and engineering to take ideas from 0* production
* Help define best practices for prompting, memory, tool use, and system architecture

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years in data science, ML, data engineering, or applied AI
* Experience building production ML systems end-to-end
* Hands-on experience with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, etc.)
* Experience with RAG, tool use, or agentic systems
* Strong Python + experience with APIs and cloud (AWS preferred)
* Databricks tooling experience preferred
* Comfortable with ambiguity and fast experimentation cycles
* Familiarity with click stream, app usage, and/or observational panel data preferred

title: AI Engineer, Design
description:
**About Nu**
============

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.  
  
Visit our Institutional Page

**About the role**
------------------

We're looking for an outstanding AI Engineer with both a passion for design and experience architecting modern AI implementations.

Nu's design and research function is roughly 260 people. Over the past year they have been building their own tooling: something like 100 AI-assisted solutions and 30+ local knowledge repositories, each built inside a business unit to solve that unit's problem. Most of them work. None of them talk to each other.

The Design Center of Excellence exists to turn that kind of local invention into systems the whole function can build on. It has design ops and research ops. It does not have an engineer — which means the CoE can identify a need, specify a tool, and then has no one to build it.

This is that hire: the first engineer in the CoE, and the person who architects the systems that let design at Nu scale. You'll work directly with the designers and researchers who use what you build, and the person who scopes a system is the person who builds it.

**What you'll work on**
-----------------------

**NuBrain** — the first priority. A global knowledge system for the design and research function, consolidating the 30+ local repositories that already exist. The hard part is not merging content; it's the context architecture — how retrieval is structured, how token consumption stays sane, and how content reaches people and agents at the moment it's useful.

**New tools that enable superlative creative marketing and brand expressions at scale**. As Nu scales globally, we are inventing new ways to express our brand in the product and through our marketing. Instead of hiring fleets of marketing designers in every country, we aim to build tools that enable consistent high quality creative expression to be driven centrally.

**Canonicalizing what already exists.** Roughly 100 AI solutions have been built locally by designers and researchers. Someone needs to understand what they are, decide what becomes standard for the function, and retire the rest before the duplication compounds.

**Deciding the shape of the answer.** Plugin, MCP server, agent, Claude skill, or a full platform — that call is yours to make and defend. Part of the job is telling the CoE that the tool they asked for should be something else.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Architect and build the systems design at Nu runs on — increasingly agentic ones.
* Sit with designers and researchers, understand the need underneath the request, and turn it into something scoped and buildable.
* Stand up or reuse the infrastructure, write the code, and ship it to the function.
* Instrument what you build. Metrics and observability are part of the deliverable, not a follow-up.
* Own the roadmap for CoE tooling: prioritize, sequence, say no, and keep things moving without a PM behind you.
* Be the technical voice in a design organization — make trade-offs legible to people who don't read code.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

**An outstanding, deeply experienced AI engineer.** This is an engineering hire first. You've spent years building systems other people build on, and recent years working with AI models on things like token consumption, rate limiting, response latency, MCP servers, and other modern AI engineering challenges.

**A track record architecting UX systems.** Before AI, you designed and built the foundations of user experience at scale — design systems, component platforms, UI frameworks, front-end infrastructure used by many teams.

**A love for design that shows up in your work.** Since AI, you've used it to build compelling examples and more sophisticated systems than were possible before. We'd like to see them.

**Agentic systems that help design scale.** Ideally you've built them — agents, tooling, or infrastructure that let designers do more, faster, and better. This is the strongest signal for the role.

**A protagonist.** You'll serve a 260-person function as a centralized hub. That means navigating stakeholders, leading projects, and pushing work through an organization that doesn't report to you. You drive the work yourself rather than relying on someone else to run the project.

**Evidence you've shipped.** Send us GitHub, live tools, demos, and systems you can walk us through. We are not asking for a design portfolio.

### **Backgrounds that tend to fit**

* Design systems and UI platform engineers at design-led product companies.
* Engineers at design tooling companies.
* Engineers who have been building AI and agentic tools for designers — in their day job, in open source, or in public.
* Founders and technical leads who were the engineer behind a design-led product.

### **What this role is not**

* Not a designer who codes. The engineering bar is the bar.
* Not a generalist backend or infrastructure role. UX systems experience is core.
* Not customer-facing mobile product work. This is internal systems and tooling for the design function.
* Not a research or modeling role. (The "design modeling" profile — building the models AI consumes — is a different conversation, later.)

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.  
  
To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

description:
### ***About Givzey | Version2.ai***

*Givzey |* *Version2.ai* (http://version2.ai) *is a fully remote, AI-native company that created the Autonomous Fundraising category in 2024, when it researched, developed, and deployed the world's first Autonomous AI to address the labor shortage and capacity gap in nonprofit fundraising. Fundraising teams have a finite capacity to reach donors with one-to-one communication, on average leaving 97% of donors to their organization receiving only marketing communications. A labor shortage compounds the problem: even when organizations want to hire more fundraisers, they often can't find them. The result is a significant capacity gap, where teams can't reach large pools of high-potential donors, resulting in important organizations with world-changing missions being unable to fully execute on their visions.*

*Version2.ai's Virtual Engagement Officers (VEOs) close the labor shortage gap with each VEO independently managing a portfolio of up to 1,000 donors, delivering personalized outreach through text, email, video, and robotically handwritten notes year-round. VEOs don't just make staff more efficient; they manage donor portfolios independently, freeing human fundraisers to focus their time on the highest-value relationships while also closing transformational revenue for these organizations.*

*VEOs have already generated over $20M in fundraising revenue to date, including individual gifts as large as $100,000, at an opt-out rate of just 0.07%. Organizations deploying a VEO see 4x annual ROI on average, and the top 20% see 8x or higher. More than 250 VEOs are now deployed across higher education, healthcare, and nonprofit organizations in the U.S. and Canada, including UNICEF USA, Bucknell University, Wake Forest University, and William & Mary.*

*Adam Martel founded Givzey four years ago and leads the company as CEO. He previously founded, scaled, and sold Gravyty, the first company to develop and sell AI-first solutions to nonprofit organizations.*

**About the Role**
------------------

We're hiring a **Senior Applied AI Engineer** to lead the technical design and delivery of high-impact AI initiatives across our products.

This is a senior individual contributor and technical leadership role for an experienced software engineer with deep expertise in building production AI systems. You'll lead small teams of engineers responsible for delivering sophisticated AI capabilities, from agentic workflows and retrieval systems to autonomous business processes and intelligent product experiences.

We're looking for someone who brings more than technical expertise. You should be capable of taking ownership of complex initiatives, breaking ambiguous problems into actionable engineering work, making sound architectural decisions, and guiding a team from concept through production delivery.

Equally important, you'll play a significant role in **raising the technical maturity of our engineering organization**. Through mentorship, code reviews, architectural guidance, and hands-on collaboration, you'll help establish higher standards for software quality, testing, reliability, and maintainability.

We value engineers who combine deep technical ability with practical judgment, strong ownership, and a genuine investment in making the people around them better.

**What You'll Work On**
-----------------------

* Agentic AI systems that autonomously execute complex, multi-step business workflows.
* AI-powered product experiences combining LLMs, retrieval, backend services, and human oversight.
* Retrieval and knowledge systems that connect AI agents to organization-specific information.
* Backend services, APIs, and tool integrations enabling AI systems to safely interact with production applications.
* Evaluation, observability, and testing frameworks that improve the quality, consistency, and reliability of AI behavior.
* Orchestration systems and infrastructure supporting scalable, production-grade AI applications.
* Engineering tooling and practices that improve development velocity, software quality, and operational reliability.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Technical Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead small teams of engineers in the design, development, and delivery of complex, high-impact AI initiatives.
* Own the technical execution of projects from initial design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation.
* Translate ambiguous product requirements into clear technical approaches, actionable engineering tasks, and achievable delivery milestones.
* Drive architectural discussions, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and establish sound implementation strategies.
* Coordinate engineering efforts, identify dependencies and blockers, and maintain accountability for technical execution and delivery commitments.
* Remain actively involved in implementation, contributing production code and solving challenging technical problems alongside the team.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering leadership, and stakeholders to ensure technical solutions deliver meaningful business outcomes.

### **Applied AI Engineering**

* Design, build, and maintain production-grade AI systems using LLMs, agentic workflows, retrieval architectures, and backend services.
* Develop sophisticated agent workflows involving tool calling, structured outputs, multi-step reasoning, deterministic validation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Build and optimize retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, including ingestion pipelines, embeddings, semantic retrieval, and context assembly.
* Integrate foundation models through platforms such as Amazon Bedrock and AWS AgentCore.
* Develop evaluation frameworks for AI workflows, including regression testing, golden datasets, trace analysis, and quality measurement.
* Improve production AI systems for reliability, accuracy, latency, observability, and cost efficiency.
* Design systems that safely handle unpredictable model behavior, edge cases, operational failures, and real-world production constraints.

### **Engineering Excellence & Mentorship**

* **Elevate engineering standards** through thoughtful code reviews, architectural guidance, hands-on mentorship, and technical leadership.
* Mentor engineers in software design, debugging, testing strategies, system architecture, and production engineering practices.
* Establish and reinforce best practices around code quality, automated testing, documentation, maintainability, and operational readiness.
* Help engineers develop stronger technical judgment, ownership, independence, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Identify recurring technical weaknesses, unnecessary complexity, and process inefficiencies, and actively work to address them.
* Promote a culture of thoughtful engineering where solutions are not simply functional, but reliable, understandable, testable, and maintainable.
* Lead by example through high-quality implementation, effective collaboration, constructive feedback, and strong personal accountability.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* US citizen or authorized to work in the United States.
* **7+ years of professional software engineering experience**, with substantial experience designing and delivering production systems.
* Strong proficiency in Python and modern backend software engineering.
* Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership for engineering projects or small teams, including architecture, implementation, mentorship, and delivery.
* Proven hands-on experience designing, building, and shipping production AI applications using LLMs, agentic workflows, retrieval systems, or related technologies.
* Strong knowledge of backend architecture, APIs, distributed systems, databases, and workflow orchestration.
* Experience designing agentic workflows, tool-calling systems, structured outputs, or retrieval-augmented generation architectures.
* Strong understanding of production AI challenges, including model reliability, hallucination mitigation, evaluation, observability, latency, and cost management.
* Demonstrated commitment to software engineering best practices, including automated testing, code review, CI/CD, system design, and maintainability.
* Experience working with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS.
* Proven ability to mentor engineers, provide constructive technical feedback, and influence engineering practices.
* Strong technical judgment, debugging skills, and the ability to navigate complex systems and ambiguous requirements.
* Ability to balance hands-on engineering contributions with technical leadership responsibilities.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working across engineering, product, and business teams.
* Experience operating in fast-moving environments where ownership, adaptability, and execution are essential.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with Amazon Bedrock, AWS AgentCore, Lambda, Step Functions, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, SQS, or related AWS services.
* Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, DSPy, Semantic Kernel, or similar agent orchestration frameworks.
* Experience building multi-step autonomous agents that interact with tools, APIs, external systems, or business workflows.
* Experience developing AI evaluation frameworks, prompt regression testing, trace analysis, or human-in-the-loop review systems.
* Experience with vector databases and semantic retrieval technologies such as OpenSearch, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, or FAISS.
* Experience with LLM observability and evaluation platforms such as LangSmith, Arize, Helicone, Weights & Biases, or OpenTelemetry.
* Experience leading technical initiatives within startup or rapidly scaling SaaS organizations.
* Experience improving engineering practices, introducing development standards, or helping teams increase their technical maturity.
* Experience balancing technical debt, delivery speed, operational reliability, and long-term architectural decisions.

**Who Thrives in This Role**
----------------------------

We're looking for an engineer who naturally takes ownership and leads through technical expertise, sound judgment, and example.

Someone who can look at a complicated technical problem, develop a clear approach, bring other engineers along, and drive the work through completion.

Someone who cares deeply about code quality and engineering craftsmanship, but understands the importance of pragmatism and delivering real value.

Someone who enjoys mentoring engineers, challenging assumptions, providing constructive feedback, and helping teammates become more capable and independent.

Someone who understands that technical leadership means being accountable not only for their own contributions, but also for the quality and success of the work they help lead.

**Above all, we're looking for someone who makes both our AI systems and our engineering organization stronger.**

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* High-impact AI initiatives are delivered successfully through effective technical leadership, clear ownership, and strong collaboration.
* AI systems are reliable, observable, maintainable, and trusted by customers and internal teams.
* Engineers working alongside you demonstrate measurable growth in technical ability, independence, and engineering judgment.
* Code quality, testing practices, architectural consistency, and operational reliability improve across the teams you lead.
* Complex technical initiatives move from ambiguous requirements to production-ready solutions with greater consistency and predictability.
* Engineering decisions balance innovation, delivery speed, maintainability, and long-term business value.
* Your technical leadership enables the broader organization to deliver increasingly sophisticated AI capabilities with confidence.

CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. At CCC, we’re making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We’re pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com.

**The Role**
============

CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi-trillion-dollar insurance economy, creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we’re making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We’re pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com.  
  
The Role:  
You will build and ship LLM-powered features and agentic workflows for our customers. These features automate the routine parts of a claim and guide customers on the rest, so they have to earn that trust with measured accuracy, not a convincing demo. Agents run as steps inside deterministic workflows, and privacy and security are design baselines, not review gates. Agentic coding tools are how you move fast. What you add is what they are worst at: system design, security, and hard debugging. You own features end to end.

**Key Responsibilities:**
=========================

* Ship LLM-powered features and agentic workflows in Python and TypeScript, from a problem scoped with product managers and data scientists through production traffic, and help set the metrics you will be measured against.
* Write the evals, guardrails, and feedback loops that make your features trustworthy, and hold them to explicit token and latency budgets.
* Use agentic coding tools every day, and own the review of what they produce: catch the correctness, security, and design problems in generated code before you open the pull request.
* Maintain and extend the NLP pipelines that turn unstructured claim data into structured data customers can act on, blending semantic search, classical NLP, and LLMs.
* Build and operate durable, event-driven services in which agents run as steps inside deterministic workflows, with checkpointed model outputs so a retry does not re-invoke a completed LLM step.
* Trace every model call and agent step so a recommendation can be reconstructed and audited, with citations back to the source documents, and wire that tracing into your alerts.
* Model and query claims data across relational, document, and graph stores.
* Design privacy and security in from the start: tenant isolation, least-privilege access for agents and their tools, and a clear rule for what data may reach a model provider.
* Write a technical design document before any significant change, and use it to get feedback and buy-in from the team before you build.
* Take part in a shared on-call rotation for the services you build.

**Requirements:**
=================

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least one LLM-powered feature you shipped and then operated in production.
* Python and TypeScript: typed, tested, async code in both, and real depth in one.
* Evals you have designed for LLM output, plus guardrails you have shipped.
* A clear account of how you constrain an agentic coding tool's context and verify its output, from daily use of Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar on production work.
* Pipelines that blend LLMs with semantic search and classical NLP: structured output, tool calling, embedding-based retrieval, and a case where a classical technique beat an LLM.
* Services built on message- or event-driven architectures, including long-running workflows with retries, idempotent handlers, and event-sourced state, plus an LLM or agent step you ran inside one.
* Data modeling and development across relational, document, and graph databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Neo4j, including when each type fits and the partition-key, consistency, and tenant-isolation calls you made.
* Backend services built and operated on Azure or AWS, and exposure to a durable workflow engine such as Temporal or the Durable Task Scheduler.
* Technical design documents you have written to get feedback and buy-in from a team before building, and that the team then built to.
* Clear writing and discussion for technical and non-technical audiences, and code review you can give as well as take.

**Even Better if You Have:**

* React and TypeScript experience, so you can deliver a full-stack feature end to end. Chat, streaming, and citation-heavy AI experiences especially.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code such as Terraform or Bicep.
* Experience with agent frameworks, LangGraph and the Microsoft Agent Framework among them, and with the ways agents reach their tools: the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, command-line tools, and microservices.
* Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling such as LangSmith, Arize, or Braintrust, and with OpenTelemetry-based tracing.
* Experience designing A/B tests for AI features, or what-if simulations that replay historical claims through a proposed change before it ships.
* Exposure to the insurance, claims, or automotive repair domains.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* In your first six months you ship an LLM-powered feature, its evals run in CI, and you can name the metric it moved.
* When a model migration or prompt change causes a regression, the evals you wrote catch it before a customer does.
* You take ownership from concept to production with light direction, asking the right questions early.
* You care that things hold up: the services you build survive retries, partial failures, and model migrations without incidents a customer can see.
* When something goes wrong in production, the trace tells you which step and which model call, and you can show an auditor the same thing.
* Privacy and security reviews of your features find nothing that was not already designed in.
* You enjoy the craft, and it shows: engineers pick up your patterns without being told to.
* You enjoy the back-and-forth that gets a feature scoped, and you can argue a position without needing to win it.
* You embrace our ambitious, collaborative, and empathetic values, and you like problems where the answer has to be measured rather than argued.

**Interview Policy & Privacy Notice:**
======================================

A video interview is required for this position. Video interviews are transcribed. Transcriptions are retained and may be reviewed by CCC and our recruiters. Candidates are not permitted to use generative AI or automated assistance during the interviews unless explicitly allowed by the interview team for a specific exercise. Our Job Applicant Privacy Notice is available HERE.

**About CCC's Commitment to Employees:**
========================================

CCC Intelligent Solutions understands that our employees play an integral role in our vision to shape a world where life just works. Our team is defined by our values of Integrity, Customer-Focus, Innovation, Inclusion & Diversity, Tenacity, and Connection. Through diverse perspectives, purposeful innovation, and the strength of connections, our technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most.

At CCC, together everyone can thrive as we innovate and collaborate, creating employee experiences that just work. We are committed to providing opportunities for our people to make real-life impacts, advance in their careers, and contribute to CCC’s success.

CCC offers competitive compensation and benefits to support you and your families, including:

* 401K Match
* Paid time off

For more information about our benefits, please check out our careers site.

Cogniify is hiring a hands-on engineer to build secure identity and loyalty integrations for AI-assisted commerce. You will connect AI agents, merchant applications and digital identity wallets so customers can access verified membership benefits while protecting their personal information.

This role focuses on backend development, identity protocols and verifiable credentials, with Python, MCP and AI-agent runtime integration. You will build working integrations, test fraud scenarios and create reference implementations that merchants can adopt.

**What you will do**

* Build UCP integrations that carry verified loyalty information from platform agents to merchants.

* Implement OAuth Authorization Code with PKCE for customer account linking before loyalty points are redeemed or transferred.
* Design an HTTP trust-header contract and build a Cloudflare Worker verifier with JWKS caching, spoofed-header removal and rate limiting.
* Build Node.js/TypeScript middleware that exposes verified loyalty context to merchant application handlers.
* Create a verifiable credential proof of concept covering issuance to a wallet, selective disclosure, presentation and merchant verification.
* Test replay across merchants, token reuse, enumeration, account takeover and stock reservation abuse. Verify that personal information does not reach the AI agent.
* Write merchant integration guides, build reference clients and servers, and demonstrate the complete flow through a sample storefront.

**Required experience and skills**

* 5+ years of hands-on TypeScript/Node.js development, with experience building backend APIs and integrations. Familiarity with Node 22 and Next.js or a similar framework.

* Experience integrating AI-agent runtimes or tool-using LLM applications with external APIs, including MCP server or client integration and structured tool results.
* Strong HTTP fundamentals and the ability to build servers and reference clients that follow protocol specifications.
* Production implementation of OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code with PKCE, OpenID Connect and JWT/JWS token verification.
* Experience with ES256 or EdDSA signatures, JWKS key rotation, audience validation, token expiry and replay protection using token identifiers.
* Hands-on verifiable credential experience, including W3C VC 2.0, OID4VCI, OID4VP and SD-JWT VC.
* Familiarity with did:web, did:key and at least one identity wallet SDK, such as Credo or an equivalent.
* Cloudflare Workers or equivalent edge development, including KV or Durable Objects, header verification and rate limiting.
* Ability to interpret MCP, UCP, OpenID and relevant RFC specifications, including RFC 9421 and RFC 8693, and implement independently against acceptance criteria.

* BBS+ or zero-knowledge proof tooling.
* Google UCP or Merchant Center integrations.
* Loyalty programmes, promotions systems, e-commerce fraud prevention or bot management.
* Experience with Claude or comparable LLM APIs and agent SDKs.

**What you will deliver in the first 90 days**

A UCP loyalty signal and platform-agent reference implementation with Python and MCP integration; a sample merchant with loyalty tiers; an HTTP header contract, edge verifier and middleware SDK; a credential issuer, wallet and verifier proof of concept; a fraud test suite; integration guides; and a working storefront demonstration.
